description: Official 2020 edition of National Defence Strategy of Romania (Strategia Națională de Apărare a Țării) (National Defence Strategy of Romania (Strategia Națională de Apărare a Țării) (2020)), published by National Cyber Security Directorate (DNSC) & Government of Romania (dnsc.gov.ro).
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by National Cyber Security Directorate (DNSC) & Government of Romania (dnsc.gov.ro) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
